10:30 A.M. — Social Media Analytics, Room B, led by Mr. Chidi Okafor

2:30 P.M. — Customer Retention Strategies, Room C, led by Mr. Jae-min Hong

questions.question: Why did Ms. Kim send the email?

To request a change to her workshop registration

questions.question: According to the schedule, which workshop will be held in Room C?

questions.question: Which workshop will Ms. Kim most likely be unable to attend?
options: The one led by Ms. Patel
The one led by Mr. Okafor
The one led by Ms. Devlin
The one led by Mr. Hong

questions.question: What is suggested about the session Ms. Kim wants to join?

questions.question: According to the schedule, what is the maximum number of workshops an attendee may register for?

options: It will be delivered to the front entrance.

passage:
NOTICE TO ALL RIVERSIDE APARTMENTS RESIDENTS

On Tuesday, March 3, the water supply to Buildings A and B will be shut off from 9:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M. while contractors replace a section of aging pipe in the basement. Residents of Building C will not be affected. During the work, the shared laundry room will be closed for the entire day, and some drilling noise should be expected. Complimentary bottled water will be available at the front desk in the main lobby throughout the day. We apologize for the inconvenience. If you have questions, please contact the building manager, Olivia Cruz, at ocruz@riversideapts.com.

--- Passage 2 ---

To: Olivia Cruz <ocruz@riversideapts.com>
From: Mark Ellison <m.ellison@quickmail.com>
Date: February 27
Subject: Question about March 3 work

Dear Ms. Cruz,

I live in Unit 4B in Building B, and I saw the notice about the upcoming pipe replacement. I work night shifts at the hospital, so I usually sleep between 8:00 A.M. and 4:00 P.M. Could you tell me roughly how loud the work is expected to be? If it will be very noisy, I may arrange to stay with a friend that day. Also, my cousin will be visiting me that week — may I pick up two bottles of water instead of one?

Thank you,
Mark Ellison

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To announce a temporary interruption of water service
To advertise newly renovated apartment units
To remind residents to pay maintenance fees
To introduce a new building manager
questions.explanation: 공지의 핵심 내용은 3월 3일 화요일 오전 9시부터 오후 3시까지 배관 교체 공사로 인해 A동과 B동의 수도 공급이 중단된다는 안내입니다. 따라서 일시적인 단수 안내가 목적이므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: According to the notice, what will be closed on March 3?
questions.explanation: 공지에서 'the shared laundry room will be closed for the entire day'라고 명시되어 있으므로 3월 3일에 폐쇄되는 곳은 공용 세탁실입니다. 로비는 오히려 생수를 배부하는 장소이므로 (A)는 오답이고 정답은 (B)입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Mr. Ellison's apartment?
options: It is located in Building C.
Its water supply will be affected by the work.
It has a private laundry machine.
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. Mr. Ellison은 이메일에서 자신이 Building B의 Unit 4B에 산다고 밝혔고, 공지에서는 'the water supply to Buildings A and B will be shut off'라고 했습니다. 따라서 그의 집은 단수의 영향을 받게 되므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Where can Mr. Ellison pick up bottled water on March 3?
options: At the front desk in the lobby

questions.question: Why is Mr. Ellison concerned about the noise?
options: He works from home during the day.
He sleeps during the daytime hours.
He records music in his apartment.
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 Mr. Ellison은 병원에서 야간 근무를 하기 때문에 보통 오전 8시부터 오후 4시까지 잠을 잔다고 설명하며 공사 소음 수준을 문의했습니다. 공사 시간(9 A.M.–3 P.M.)이 그의 수면 시간과 겹치기 때문이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

passage:
JOB OPENING — Senior Graphic Designer
Vela Studio, Austin, Texas

Vela Studio, an award-winning creative agency, is seeking a senior graphic designer to join our growing team. Requirements include at least five years of professional design experience, proficiency in industry-standard design software, and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Experience with product packaging design is preferred but not required. This is a full-time, on-site position based at our Austin office. To apply, send a cover letter and portfolio to careers@velastudio.com by April 20. Interviews will be conducted during the first week of May.

--- Passage 2 ---

To: careers@velastudio.com
From: Nina Sorel <nsorel@inboxnet.com>
Date: April 18
Subject: Application — Senior Graphic Designer

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the senior graphic designer position posted on your Web site. I have spent the past seven years at Calloway Print Group, where I currently lead a team of three junior designers. Last year, I directed the complete packaging redesign for a national beverage brand, a project that increased the client's shelf visibility and was featured in a design magazine. My portfolio is attached, including samples from that campaign. I am excited about the possibility of relocating to Austin; however, I would like to ask whether occasional remote workdays are possible. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Nina Sorel

questions.question: Why did Ms. Sorel send the email?
options: To apply for an advertised position
To ask about an internship program
questions.explanation: 이메일 첫 문장에서 'I am writing to apply for the senior graphic designer position'이라고 밝히고 있으므로, 이메일의 목적은 채용 공고에 지원하는 것입니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: According to the job posting, when is the application deadline?
questions.explanation: 공고에서 'send a cover letter and portfolio to careers@velastudio.com by April 20'이라고 명시되어 있으므로 지원 마감일은 4월 20일입니다. 4월 18일은 Ms. Sorel이 이메일을 보낸 날짜이므로 혼동하지 않아야 합니다. 정답은 (B)입니다.

questions.question: What requirement does Ms. Sorel exceed?
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 공고에서는 'at least five years of professional design experience'를 요구하는데, Ms. Sorel은 이메일에서 'I have spent the past seven years at Calloway Print Group'이라고 밝혔습니다. 7년의 경력은 최소 요건인 5년을 초과하므로 (A)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Why is Ms. Sorel likely to be considered a strong candidate?
options: She has experience in a preferred area.
She previously worked at Vela Studio.
She is willing to accept a lower salary.
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 공고에서 'Experience with product packaging design is preferred'라고 했는데, Ms. Sorel은 음료 브랜드의 패키징 리디자인을 총괄한 경험이 있다고 이메일에 썼습니다. 우대 사항에 해당하는 경력을 갖추었으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 그녀는 Austin으로 이주를 고려 중이므로 (B)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Sorel ask about in her email?
options: The salary range for the position
The size of the design team
The possibility of working remotely at times
questions.explanation: 이메일 후반부에서 Ms. Sorel은 'I would like to ask whether occasional remote workdays are possible'이라고 물었습니다. 즉, 가끔 재택근무가 가능한지를 문의한 것이므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

passage:
HARBORVIEW HOTEL — GUEST INVOICE

Guest: Thomas Liang
Room: 612 (Deluxe King)
Check-in: October 5 / Check-out: October 8

Charges:
Room rate — $150.00 per night x 3 nights: $450.00
Valet parking — $20.00 per night x 3 nights: $60.00
Minibar purchases: $35.00
Total due: $545.00

Payment received: Credit card ending in 4417
Questions about your bill? Contact billing@harborviewhotel.com.

--- Passage 2 ---

To: billing@harborviewhotel.com
From: Thomas Liang <tliang@corvusconsulting.com>
Date: October 9
Subject: Invoice corrections — Room 612

To Whom It May Concern,

I stayed at your hotel last week and received my invoice this morning. I believe it contains two errors. First, I was charged $35.00 for minibar purchases, but I did not open the minibar at any time during my stay. Second, when I booked my room by telephone in September, your reservations agent confirmed that I would receive the corporate rate of $135.00 per night through my company's agreement with your hotel. The invoice instead shows the standard nightly rate. Please send me a corrected invoice and refund the difference to my credit card. I have stayed at your property many times and trust this can be resolved quickly.

Regards,
Thomas Liang

questions.question: Why did Mr. Liang write the email?
options: To dispute charges on his bill
To request a copy of a receipt
questions.explanation: Mr. Liang은 청구서에 두 가지 오류가 있다고 지적하며('I believe it contains two errors') 수정된 청구서와 차액 환불을 요청하고 있습니다. 즉, 청구 내역에 이의를 제기하는 것이 목적이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: According to the invoice, how many nights did Mr. Liang stay at the hotel?
questions.explanation: 청구서에 '$150.00 per night x 3 nights'라고 표시되어 있고, 체크인 10월 5일부터 체크아웃 10월 8일까지는 3박에 해당합니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: Which charge does Mr. Liang claim he should not have received at all?
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 청구서에는 'Minibar purchases: $35.00'가 포함되어 있는데, Mr. Liang은 이메일에서 'I did not open the minibar at any time during my stay'라고 하며 이 요금 자체가 잘못 부과되었다고 주장합니다. 객실 요금은 금액이 잘못되었다고 했을 뿐 부과 자체를 부정한 것은 아니므로 (C)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: By how much does Mr. Liang believe he was overcharged for each night's stay?
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 청구서에는 1박당 $150.00가 부과되었지만, Mr. Liang은 전화 예약 시 1박당 $135.00의 기업 할인 요금을 확인받았다고 주장합니다. 따라서 1박당 과다 청구액은 $150.00 − $135.00 = $15.00이므로 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: How did Mr. Liang make his reservation?
options: In person at the front desk
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'when I booked my room by telephone in September'라고 언급했으므로 Mr. Liang은 전화로 예약했음을 알 수 있습니다. 따라서 (B)가 정답입니다.

questions.question: What does Ms. Nair ask about in her email?
